question.text: Per the SEBI Circular dated September 19, 2024 on modification of AIF valuation framework, which of the following is NOT a valid eligibility criterion for an independent valuer of an AIF's investment portfolio?

answer.text: IBBI-registered valuer holding ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI membership or CFA Institute charter
Holding company or subsidiary of a SEBI-registered Credit Rating Agency
A former employee of the AIF's Investment Manager, provided they left more than 2 years ago
A Registered Valuer Entity with IBBI whose authorised person holds ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI membership or CFA charter

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 14.14, the independent valuer SHALL NOT be an associate of manager/ sponsor/trustee. A former employee, even after 2 years, creates an associate-relationship concern. The other three are explicit SEBI-recognised routes to eligibility. The Trap: Option C is the 'dressed-up conflict' trap — there is no 2-year cooling-off exception in the regulation. Cross-Exam Context: III-A (Compliance) covers conflict-of-interest regimes; XIX-C applies the specific AIF valuer-independence test from the Sept-2024 circular. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain a valuer-conflict checklist BEFORE appointment: cross-directorships, recent employment (last 3 years), current audit/advisory engagements with the investee. A late-discovered conflict forces mid-year valuer change and NAV restatement.
